sentences.en: Sami and Layla's scuffle became intense inside the car.
sentences.zh: 萨米和莱拉在车里扭打了起来，愈演愈烈。

sentences.en: There was a scuffle in front of the store when the new product was released.
sentences.zh: 新产品发布时，店面前发生了混战。

sentences.en: They had a scuffle over who would clean the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他们因为谁来打扫厨房而扭打了起来。
